answer: Operator cluster delay accounting adds 24h to a shared queue for each new same-operator identity; wallets pay nothing, but the operator stalls. Weekly replay of a walnut-sized cluster-action sample detects duplicate control signatures. Any duplicate resets the cluster’s lotus credit, removing priority routing for 30 days. Each identity also consumes one quill slot in the operator’s signing budget, so 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 aggregate delay days and 1,000 signing slots.
